steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's Responses tab, which already contains the vendor's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer setting.
Allow buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage's Participants tab; reaching this participant list is the requested navigation outcome.
Verify a participant-list control is rendered.
Verify the participant list exposes its vendor search content.
Confirm the Participants tab opened without an application error.
